assets.name: tidal-glass-01-sanctuary
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium desktop wallpaper for Tidal Glass, an oceanic operating-system theme. Generate one exquisitely detailed 3840 x 2160 landscape artwork, 16:9. Underwater utopian architecture seen from inside a clear glass ocean observatory: pale pearl stone, sculpted curved glass, polished shallow reflecting pools, deep sapphire and luminous cyan ocean, delicate floating translucent jellyfish, refracted sunlight and natural water caustics. Sophisticated cinematic architectural visualization, physically convincing glass and water, serene luminous atmosphere, subtle bioluminescent glow, realistic fine materials, ambitious premium art direction. Coordinated three-monitor series. Full-bleed wallpaper ONLY: absolutely no UI, no windows, no panels, no dock, no icons, no typography, no logos, no watermark, no border. Compose with uncluttered blue-water breathing room for desktop windows; avoid visual clutter, aggressive contrast and blown-out highlights. This is LEFT monitor artwork, called Sanctuary. A quiet curving pearl-stone reading alcove and low sculpted pale-blue cushions along the far left, shallow stepped water garden in the lower foreground, huge gently curving transparent wall reveals swaying luminous sea grass and an elegant school of silver fish. Open aquamarine ocean to the right with sun shafts slanting down from upper right. Curving architectural lines lead toward the right edge. Soft airy turquoise light, intimate peaceful atmosphere. No people.
